reference_transcript: Okay starting Push Day. Barbell bench press, um, sixty kilos for eight, then, uh, sixty five for six — actually no wait, that second one was sixty seven and a half. Um, incline dumbbell press, thirty two point five kilos, three sets, first two at twelve reps and the last one at ten. Push-ups, um, three sets of fifteen reps each. And, uh, overhead press, fifty kilos for eight reps.

meta.notes: mid-sentence self-correction on a weight (65->67.5, must not produce both); positional/ordinal reasoning ('first two...last one'); distributive bodyweight sets; 'fifteen' (push-ups) and 'fifty' (overhead press) both present on DIFFERENT exercises — realistic same-workout danger-pair confusion
